title: Reporting of FCNR(B) Deposits, External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs) and Overseas Foreign Currency Borrowings (OFCBs) mobilized under RBI's Swap Facility
description: RBI issued guidance on reporting requirements for FCNR(B) deposits, external commercial borrowings, and overseas foreign currency borrowings mobilized under the central bank's concessional swap facility. The facility is available until September 30, 2026 for FCNR(B) deposits and December 31, 2026 for OFCBs and ECBs.
